items.quote: From the outside, Dubai looks perfect. Sun. Luxury. Freedom.
items.statement: Dubai looks perfect but building a career there is not easy.

items.quote: Build a financial cushion — at least 6 months. Ideally 10.
items.statement: Build a financial cushion of at least 6 months, ideally 10, before moving.

items.quote: Start studying the market at least 6 months before the move.
items.statement: Start studying the market at least 6 months before moving.

items.quote: Write yourself a letter. Why are you doing this?

items.quote: unless your “why” is strong, you’ll want to give up before the rewards arrive.
items.statement: Having a strong 'why' is essential to avoid giving up.

items.quote: Dubai is fast, but real results take time.
items.statement: Real results in Dubai real estate take time despite the city's fast pace.
